name: Store Sales Summary(AIO)
report_script:
# Store Sales Summary(AIO) - Script Report
# Summarizes POS Invoice sales by store with deduplication and return handling

filters = filters or {}

from_date = filters.get("from_date") or frappe.utils.today()
to_date = filters.get("to_date") or frappe.utils.today()
companies = filters.get("company") or []

columns = [
    {"label": "No", "fieldname": "row_no", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 60},
    {"label": "Store", "fieldname": "shop", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Company", "width": 220},
    {"label": "Gross Sales", "fieldname": "total_sales", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Net Received", "fieldname": "total_paid", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
    {"label": "TC", "fieldname": "total_orders", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 100},
    {"label": "AC", "fieldname": "avg_sales", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Cash TC", "fieldname": "cash_orders", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Cash Amount", "fieldname": "cash_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Cash AC", "fieldname": "avg_cash", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 150},
]

result = []

# Build company filter condition
company_condition = ""
query_params = {
    "from_date": from_date,
    "to_date": to_date
}

if companies and len(companies) > 0:
    if isinstance(companies, str):
        companies = [companies]
    placeholder_list = []
    for i in range(len(companies)):
        param_name = "company_" + str(i)
        placeholder_list.append("%(" + param_name + ")s")
        query_params[param_name] = companies[i]
    placeholders = ", ".join(placeholder_list)
    company_condition = "AND pi.company IN (" + placeholders + ")"

# Main SQL query with CTE logic converted to subqueries for better compatibility
sql = """
SELECT
    store_data.company AS shop,
    SUM(store_data.sales_amount) AS total_sales,
    SUM(store_data.paid_amount) AS total_paid,
    SUM(store_data.order_count) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(store_data.sales_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(store_data.order_count), 0), 2) AS avg_sales,
    SUM(store_data.cash_order_count) AS cash_orders,
    SUM(store_data.cash_amount) AS cash_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(store_data.cash_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(store_data.cash_order_count), 0), 2) AS avg_cash
FROM (
    SELECT
        inv.company,
        inv.dedup_key,
        MAX(inv.sales_amount) AS sales_amount,
        MAX(inv.paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
        MAX(inv.order_count) AS order_count,
        MAX(inv.cash_amount) AS cash_amount,
        MAX(inv.cash_order_count) AS cash_order_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            pi.name,
            pi.company,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pi.po_no, ''), pi.name) AS dedup_key,
            CASE
                WHEN IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = 1 THEN -ABS(pi.grand_total)
                ELSE ABS(pi.grand_total)
            END AS sales_amount,
            CASE
                WHEN IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = 1 THEN -ABS(IFNULL(pi.paid_amount, 0))
                ELSE ABS(IFNULL(pi.paid_amount, 0))
            END AS paid_amount,
            CASE
                WHEN IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = 1 THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END AS order_count,
            CASE
                WHEN IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = 1 THEN -ABS(IFNULL(pc.cash_amount, 0))
                ELSE ABS(IFNULL(pc.cash_amount, 0))
            END AS cash_amount,
            CASE
                WHEN IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = 1 THEN 0
                WHEN ABS(IFNULL(pc.cash_amount, 0)) > 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS cash_order_count
        FROM `tabPOS Invoice` pi
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT parent AS invoice, SUM(amount) AS cash_amount
            FROM `tabSales Invoice Payment`
            WHERE mode_of_payment = 'Cash'
            GROUP BY parent
        ) pc ON pc.invoice = pi.name
        WHERE pi.docstatus = 1
          AND pi.posting_date >= %%(from_date)s
          AND pi.posting_date <= %%(to_date)s
          %s
    ) inv
    GROUP BY inv.company, inv.dedup_key
) store_data
GROUP BY store_data.company
ORDER BY store_data.company
""" % company_condition

rows = frappe.db.sql(sql, query_params, as_dict=True)

# Add row number
if rows:
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        row["row_no"] = i + 1
    result = rows
else:
    result = []

data = columns, result
